subject: Maths
cover: Quadratic Equations: every formula you need

slides.headline: Standard form
slides.sub: ax² + bx + c = 0, where a ≠ 0

slides.headline: Discriminant
slides.sub: D = b² − 4ac. It decides the nature of the roots.

slides.headline: Nature of roots
slides.sub: D > 0: two distinct real roots · D = 0: two equal real roots · D < 0: no real roots

slides.headline: Sum & product of roots
slides.sub: Sum of roots = −b/a · Product of roots = c/a

slides.headline: General term (nth term)
slides.sub: aₙ = a + (n − 1)d, where a = first term, d = common difference

slides.headline: Common difference
slides.sub: d = aₙ − aₙ₋₁ (difference between consecutive terms)

slides.headline: Sum using last term
slides.sub: Sₙ = n/2 × (a + l), where l = last term

slides.headline: The 3 main ratios
slides.sub: sin θ = opposite/hypotenuse · cos θ = adjacent/hypotenuse · tan θ = opposite/adjacent

slides.headline: Reciprocals
slides.sub: cosec θ = 1/sin θ · sec θ = 1/cos θ · cot θ = 1/tan θ

slides.headline: Quotient relations
slides.sub: tan θ = sin θ / cos θ · cot θ = cos θ / sin θ

slides.headline: The 3 identities
slides.sub: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 · 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ · 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ

subject: Maths
cover: Coordinate Geometry: the 3 formulas to memorise

slides.headline: Distance formula
slides.sub: Distance = √[ (x₂ − x₁)² + (y₂ − y₁)² ]

slides.headline: Section formula
slides.sub: Point dividing in ratio m:n = ( (mx₂ + nx₁)/(m+n), (my₂ + ny₁)/(m+n) )

slides.headline: Midpoint formula
slides.sub: Midpoint = ( (x₁ + x₂)/2, (y₁ + y₂)/2 )

slides.headline: Sphere
slides.sub: Surface area = 4πr² · Volume = (4/3)πr³

slides.headline: Hemisphere
slides.sub: Curved SA = 2πr² · Total SA = 3πr² · Volume = (2/3)πr³

slides.headline: Cylinder
slides.sub: CSA = 2πrh · TSA = 2πr(r + h) · Volume = πr²h

slides.headline: Cone
slides.sub: CSA = πrl · TSA = πr(l + r) · Volume = (1/3)πr²h · slant l = √(r² + h²)

slides.headline: Cuboid & Cube
slides.sub: Cuboid: V = lbh, TSA = 2(lb + bh + hl) · Cube: V = a³, TSA = 6a²

slides.headline: Mean (direct method)
slides.sub: Mean = Σfᵢxᵢ / Σfᵢ

slides.headline: Median
slides.sub: Median = l + [ (n/2 − cf) / f ] × h, where l = lower limit of median class

slides.headline: Mode
slides.sub: Mode = l + [ (f₁ − f₀) / (2f₁ − f₀ − f₂) ] × h

slides.headline: Empirical relation
slides.sub: 3 Median = Mode + 2 Mean

slides.headline: Probability of an event
slides.sub: P(E) = (number of favourable outcomes) / (total number of outcomes)

slides.headline: Range of probability
slides.sub: 0 ≤ P(E) ≤ 1 · P(sure event) = 1 · P(impossible event) = 0

slides.headline: Complement rule
slides.sub: P(not E) = 1 − P(E)

slides.headline: Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic
slides.sub: Every composite number can be written as a unique product of primes.

slides.headline: HCF and LCM relation
slides.sub: For two numbers: HCF × LCM = product of the two numbers

slides.headline: Finding HCF/LCM
slides.sub: Use prime factorisation: HCF = product of smallest powers, LCM = product of greatest powers.

slides.headline: Quadratic polynomial
slides.sub: For ax² + bx + c: sum of zeroes = −b/a, product of zeroes = c/a

slides.headline: Number of zeroes
slides.sub: A polynomial of degree n has at most n zeroes (graph cuts x-axis at the zeroes).

subject: Maths
cover: Linear equations: how to tell the type of solution

slides.headline: Unique solution (intersecting)
slides.sub: a₁/a₂ ≠ b₁/b₂

slides.headline: No solution (parallel)
slides.sub: a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ ≠ c₁/c₂

slides.headline: Infinite solutions (coincident)
slides.sub: a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂
